Meanwhile, Buhari’s principal challenger in last February’s presidential election, former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar of the opposition People’s Democratic Party (PDP), is still challenging the poll result. </jats:p>\\n            </jats:sec>\\n            <jats:sec sec-type=\\\"impacts\\\">\\n               <jats:title content-type=\\\"abstract-subheading\\\">Impacts</jats:title>\\n               <jats:p>Public interest in governance reforms could wane, with a shift to ensuring stability over advocating change. </jats:p>\\n               <jats:p>The military and security services will face growing scrutiny and criticism over their increased politicisation. </jats:p>\\n               <jats:p>Intensified leadership divisions within the ruling APC could increasingly frustrate Buhari’s agenda during his second term. </jats:p>\\n               <jats:p>A mooted probe of the army’s role in the recent elections is unlikely to result in any major sanctions.</jats:p>\…
